description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Zone' class in the Opencart Admin Model Localisation namespace. It defines methods for managing geographical zones, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving zone data from the database.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing localisation zones, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and fetch zones and related data from the database.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Inserts a new zone record into the database using provided data and clears the zone cache, returning the new zone's ID.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Updates an existing zone record identified by zone_id with the provided data and clears the zone cache.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Deletes the zone record with the specified zone_id from the database and clears the zone cache.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific zone by zone_id.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Returns a list of zones, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Fetches all active zones belonging to a specific country identified by country_id.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of zones, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of zones for a specific country.
